message: I always keep my trusty weather radio and a jug of water handy in the laundry room. You never know when the power might take a vacation during a storm, and I’d rather not be stuck scrolling my phone for updates while it’s dying on me. Plus, who doesn’t love a little old-school reassurance? What’s your go-to prep item for a stormy day? 🌧️
scene: a weather radio and a jug of water on a laundry-room shelf (in soft morning light)
